Christopher Nolan Has Directed Quay, A Short Doc About Animators the Brothers Quay

Amazing spooky imagery in their work. The literary allusions will be lost on pretty much everyone though. Serious eastern European surrealist stuff. They namedrop Jan Švankmajer a lot. He's made a few movies which are a bit more intellectually accessible (Alice, Little Ottik). They've made two live action films "Institute Benjamenta" about a school for butlers (lots of great visuals again and the actors are all great) and "The piano tuner of earthquakes" (which I haven't seen, but own, as I'm waiting to be in the right mindset rather than watch it as "home work" LOL).

If you're a fan of TOOL's music videos, you already know many of the Quay's stylistics. Very similar but screechy violins and eastern bloc classical music instead of industrial rock.

Peter Greenaway based the main characters of "A Zed and Two Naughts" on them. Except those twins do time-lapse films of animals rotting (the final work being a film of themselves). Worth checking out if you get on a Quay burn.

Edit: And if you get on a "Creepy Twins" burn, also check out David Cronenberg's "Dead Ringers".
